name: Pulsar International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Pulsar International Ltd is in the business of agricultural supply chain management.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PIL is a Gujarat-based enterprise engaged 
in integrated agri-supply chain management (SCM) with a focus on agriculture, technology-based agricultural applications, wholesale trade, and contract farming. The company primarily operates in the procurement, processing, and distribution of perishable commodities, especially fresh fruits and vegetables.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 1,327 days to 141 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 246 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -22.9%
